subject: Clarifying the unfinished task deadline
text: I need a clarification about the deadline for the unfinished task. In last week’s meeting, the wording suggested that the current submission window would close on Friday, but the shared outline appears to extend the final review by two days. As team lead, I want to make sure our members are not planning around the wrong date. Please confirm whether the deadline is the original Friday, the later date, or a flexible checkpoint that can move if the remaining materials need more time. If the date is firm, we will prioritize completing the outstanding sections, double-checking the evidence table, and preparing a short summary before closing the review window. If the later date is intended, we will continue working through the data annotations and send you the task status before the revised cutoff. I also want to avoid adding unnecessary pressure on anyone, especially since part of the task depends on feedback that has not returned yet. A reply with the exact deadline, the required deliverable, and whether the unfinished portion must be fully resolved before the due time would be enough for me to align the group. If there is a preferred submission format or a specific person who should receive the completed materials, please include that.
